crew.overview: During a manned mission to Mars, Astronaut Mark Watney is presumed dead after a fierce storm and left behind by his crew. But Watney has survived and finds himself stranded and alone on the hostile planet. With only meager supplies, he must draw upon his ingenuity, wit and spirit to subsist and find a way to signal to Earth that he is alive.
crew.title: The Martian

details.biography: Hanna Griffiths is an Australian-born, award-winning actress and producer whose bold approach to storytelling has earned her recognition on both sides of the camera. With a background shaped by work at iconic studios like Paramount, Warner Bros., and Disney, she’s contributed to a variety of critically acclaimed films that have resonated globally. Hanna’s talent as been celebrated as the “Breakout Producer” by Women in Film and named “Best Female Filmmaker” by Pinewood Studios London. Recently, she was honored as one of the “Ones to Watch” by Screen Producers Australia.
details.name: Hanna Griffiths
